prose: Daring Fireball links to developer David Smith's observation that iOS 27 adoption is on a different path from past years. It is still growing steadily, at the rate of the usual steady phase, but without the big surge at the start.
The page gives Smith's note from the previous week and John Gruber's framing that Apple is slow-rolling adoption. Only the excerpt was reviewed, so the reasons are not covered here.
highlights: iOS 27 adoption lacks the usual early surge
Growth is steady, similar to normal later phases
Source is David Smith's post, linked by Daring Fireball
Reasons not given in the excerpt
